Wave Management: Push, Freeze and Crash

Control where the minion wave sits in your lane, and you control when fights happen, how safe you are, and how much gold your opponent gets.

Trading in Lane

Learn when to hit your opponent, when to back off, and how to come out ahead in every exchange of damage.

IntermediateLaning7 min

Recall Timing and Tempo

When you go back to base matters as much as what you buy. Good recalls keep you strong, safe and on time for objectives.

Objectives: Dragons, Grubs, Herald and Baron

Neutral objectives win games. Learn what each one gives you, when it spawns, and how to set up so your team gets it.

IntermediateTeamfighting8 min

Teamfighting Basics

Five against five is chaos, but it doesn't have to be. Learn your job in a fight, where to stand, and who to hit.

IntermediateMacro7 min

Roaming and Map Pressure

Leaving your lane to help elsewhere can win games, or throw away your lead. Learn when to roam, how to do it, and what to do when your opponent disappears.

Tracking the Enemy Jungler

Most early deaths come from the enemy jungler. Learn to guess where they are, so you know when to play safe and when to go for it.

Reading the Enemy Team: Pick and Build Against It

Spot what the enemy team wants to do, then choose a champion and items that shut it down: armor or magic resist, anti-heal, tank shredding, and answers to dive, poke and crowd control.

IntermediateChampion picks9 min

Team Synergy: Building a Comp That Works

Five strong champions don't always make a strong team. Learn to balance damage types, frontline, engage, peel and wave clear, and how the main team composition types win.

IntermediateLaning9 min

Melee vs. Ranged Lanes

Laning as a melee champion against a ranged one feels unfair, but it's very playable. Learn how to survive and win as the melee side, and how to punish melee champions when you're the ranged one.

Advanced

AdvancedMacro8 min

Side Lanes & Split Pushing

After laning ends, games are won by who controls the side lanes. Learn who should be where, how to split push without throwing, and how to run a 1-3-1.

AdvancedLaning8 min

Power Spikes: Know When You're Strong

Every champion has moments where they suddenly get much stronger. Learn the level, item and objective spikes, and how to fight on yours and avoid the enemy's.

AdvancedVision8 min

Advanced Vision Control

Vision wins objectives. Learn when to set up before Dragon and Baron, how to sweep, where to deep ward, how to use Faelights, and how to deny the enemy's sight.

AdvancedLaning8 min

Matchups, Cooldowns & Lane Priority

Win lane before it starts: learn matchups efficiently, track enemy Flash and key abilities, punish cooldown windows, and use lane priority to win 2v2s with your jungler.

AdvancedMacro9 min

Win Conditions & Team Comps

Every team has a plan that wins. Learn to spot your team's win condition, the five comp types, drafting basics, and how to play from ahead and from behind.

AdvancedMental8 min

The Mental Game: Tilt, Focus & Improving

Your mindset decides how much you improve. Learn to control tilt, review your own games, set goals, choose a champion pool, and know when to stop for the day.

Counter picks win lanes when they're used well and lose games when they're not. Learn what makes a counter, when comfort beats it, and how to use a last pick for the whole team.
